page.layout: One page, no text blocks. A library stamp (STADT BIBLIOTHEK ZURICH) sits in the centre. Faint mirrored print from the reverse side shows through above and below the stamp. A handwritten shelf mark is at the foot.
page.notes: The page carries no printed text of its own. The large faint lines at the top, and the fainter lines in the lower half, are show-through from the printed title on the other side, so they are not transcribed. The violet circular stamp (Stadt Bibliothek Zürich, with a shield and crown) and the handwritten shelf mark at the bottom edge are library marks and are excluded.
